title: CRANE RESCUE
oneLiner: Climb the construction tower, leap rolling barrels and rescue the kitten from a mischievous gorilla.
mechanics: Five sloped girders connected by usable ladders; broken shortcuts are visibly marked.
A construction gorilla telegraphs and throws barrels. Barrels roll downhill, fall off edges and sometimes descend ladders.
Jumping over a barrel awards 100 only once per player and barrel; reaching each new floor awards 100.
Reach the kitten at the upper-right cage to rescue it, earn a time bonus and advance to a different, harder layout.
Each player has three lives and respawns at the highest reached floor with temporary protection. In 2P, either player can rescue the kitten for the team.
lose: The team runs out of lives; running out of stage time costs a life.
scoring: 100 for each new floor and each distinct barrel jumped; 1000 plus the remaining stage bonus when the kitten is rescued.
note: Original construction art and code inspired by the barrel-ladder arcade structure.
